passages.text: We must be always ready to sit at the feet of all, for, mark you, every one can teach us great lessons. Says our great lawgiver, Manu: “Receive some good knowledge even from the low-born, and even from the man of lowest birth learn by service the road to heaven.”
passages.note: Humility; being willing to learn from anyone

passages.text: The first manifest effect of life is expansion. You must expand if you want to live. The moment you have ceased to expand, death is upon you, danger is ahead.
passages.note: Growth versus stagnation; stepping beyond comfort
